Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.71 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 757 W·min/l (98% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 3.43 l/min (48% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.1 bar (23% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
